searchText: We would like to perform another large stress test on devnet-12 and EIP-4844 BLOBs, which needs about 5000 test ETH. Could anyone from ACD send us? Our test address is 0x8591a34Dc89E7A801F1f7e1F5eCaB48Dd4a7c9e6. Thanks in advance!
